requirements.text: You have hands-on experience with LLMs, agents, retrieval, prompting, and production AI systems.
You can build clean, reliable product experiences end to end.
You’re comfortable with cloud services, deployment, observability, reliability, and security.
You know how to design tests, benchmarks, and feedback loops to measure model and agent quality.
You’re pragmatic, fast-moving, product-minded, and comfortable owning ambiguous technical problems.
You care deeply about the people using what you build, not just the technical elegance of the solution.
You’ve built things outside of work -- maybe a Minecraft server as a kid, a side project, a tool for your friends, a company, an open-source project, or something nobody asked you to build.
Note: This role is in-person in New York City and you are required to ship code.
